roles.name: Student
roles.evidence_quote: The student will log in to view attendance, announcements, and grades, and to customize their profile.

roles.name: Teacher
roles.evidence_quote: Teacher – Attendance Use case: The teacher opens the Attendance page, selects Class and Date, and marks students as Present/Absent.

roles.name: Admin
permissions: create, update, deactivate, and search student records
view and export attendance and grade reports
roles.evidence_quote: Admin – Student Management Use case: The admin creates, updates, deactivates, and searches student records.

requirements.text: After successful login, the system shall open the Student Dashboard showing widgets for Attendance, Announcements, and Grades.
requirements.evidence_quote: After successful login, the system shall open the Student Dashboard showing widgets for Attendance, Announcements, and Grades.

requirements.text: The user dashboard (Admin, Teacher, or Student) shall load and display all key summary widgets (e.g., current announcements, grade summaries, quick links) within 8 seconds of successful login.
requirements.evidence_quote: The user dashboard (Admin, Teacher, or Student) shall load and display all key summary widgets (e.g., current announcements, grade summaries, quick links) within 8 seconds of successful login.

requirements.text: The total time required to process and save a full class attendance record (from clicking Save to receiving the success message) shall not exceed 5 seconds.
requirements.evidence_quote: The total time required to process and save a full class attendance record (from clicking Save to receiving the success message) shall not exceed 5 seconds.

requirements.text: All filtering operations on lists (e.g., filtering student records by class, or filtering reports by terms) shall return results within 5 seconds.
requirements.evidence_quote: All filtering operations on lists (e.g., filtering student records by class, or filtering reports by terms) shall return results within 5 seconds.

requirements.text: The system shall publish grades for a class of up to 50 students, making them visible to students, within 8 seconds of the teacher clicking the Publish button.
requirements.evidence_quote: The system shall publish grades for a class of up to 50 students, making them visible to students, within 8 seconds of the teacher clicking the Publish button.

requirements.text: The time taken for the system to generate and present an exportable grade report or attendance summary (PDF/CSV) for a single class over one term shall not exceed 10 seconds.
requirements.evidence_quote: The time taken for the system to generate and present an exportable grade report or attendance summary (PDF/CSV) for a single class over one term shall not exceed 10 seconds.
